skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts of multimodal transport management, including logistics operations, service design, cost analysis, decision-making, and legal issues.
Design, implement, and control logistics services in multimodal transport.
Analyze and determine costs and pricing strategies in multimodal transport management.
Identify and process information to make informed decisions in multimodal transport management.
Coordinate and execute group projects related to multimodal transport management.
Resolve conflicts and manage group dynamics during project execution.
Understand and apply legal regulations in multimodal transport management.
Analyze and evaluate the core tasks in logistics management.
Effectively present project outcomes and engage in discussions.
Produce structured and logical reports on multimodal transport projects.
